_doc: Optimal mobile GPU config via Vulkan (Adreno / Mali / PowerVR).
WHY these flags:
backend_type: vulkan — Uses the Vulkan compute pipeline. Preferred over OpenCL
on devices where the Vulkan driver is more mature (most
Samsung Exynos/Mali and recent MediaTek Dimensity SoCs).
gpu_mode flags become MNN's thread_num directly (no separate threads field for GPU).
gpu_mode flags (bitwise-ORed):
MNN_GPU_TUNING_WIDE (1<<2 = 4)
— Benchmarks local-workgroup-size candidates on first run and caches results.
Per MNNForwardType.h:63, only TUNING_NONE/HEAVY/WIDE are valid for Vulkan.
MNN_GPU_RECORD_BATCH (1<<9 = 512)
— Per MNNForwardType.h:76-78, for Vulkan this makes all ops share a single
VkCommandBuffer. Eliminates per-op vkQueueSubmit overhead and enables the
driver to reorder/fuse dispatches across the entire decoder layer.
NOTE: MNN_GPU_MEMORY_BUFFER / MNN_GPU_MEMORY_IMAGE are OpenCL-only flags and
must NOT be set for Vulkan — they are meaningless and may cause undefined behavior.
precision: low       — FP16 compute via VK_KHR_shader_float16_int8. All Vulkan
1.1+ mobile GPUs support this; doubles ALU throughput.
memory: low          — Compact Vulkan memory allocation; reuses VkDeviceMemory
blocks across non-overlapping op lifetimes.
power: high          — Hints maximum GPU frequency to the driver.
quant_qkv: 11        — KV cache: K=INT8 + V=FP8 + flash attention (3|8).
use_mmap: true       — Memory-maps weights before staging to GPU.
QKV_QUANT_OPTIONS: 11 — Applied via RuntimeManager::setHint to configure the
flash-attention + KV quantisation path.
KVCACHE_SIZE_LIMIT: -1 — No per-layer cap; keep entire KV cache in GPU memory.
